summary: Prior QMS verification record (2026-09-27-pass-layer1-api-parity.json) was written with a UTF-8 BOM and a missing closing brace and had to be repaired by the lead.
root_cause: Used PowerShell 5.1 Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 (which prepends a BOM) with a hand-typed here-string JSON, and closed the task without validating parseability (no json.load / ConvertFrom-Json check).
what_i_did_wrong: Relied on manual JSON construction and PS encoding quirks instead of programmatic json.dumps, and skipped a parse-validation step before finishing.
corrective_action: All future JSON records written via Python json.dump with encoding utf-8 (no BOM) and validated with json.load before task close. Applied this session: VER-2026-0927-G6E1-VERIFY validated in-line.
